about: Memory map of the translator (STM32N6570-DK). tools/models_layout.py checks it and writes xl_models.h;
tools/flash.py n6 --models programs every flash entry that has a file. Paths are relative to the repository.
NPU networks (asr, vocoder, flow) have their flash and PSRAM addresses compiled in by ST Edge AI:
model-tools/mpool_edit.py writes their memory-pool files from this map. Sizes in bytes.

flash.name: app
flash.what: Application, run in place (linker region NOR_APP)

flash.name: asr
flash.what: Speech recognition weights (NPU, cynipsnet_punct1; address fixed by its compile)

flash.name: tts_front
flash.what: Voice front end weights for the CPU (tts_front_pack.py)

flash.name: font
flash.what: Devanagari syllable font, 40 px, run-length coded (hi_font_rle.py)

psram_regions.name: work
psram_regions.what: Shared, in turn: the translation workspace, or the voice (the two regions below)

psram_regions.name: voice_work
psram_regions.what: Voice: front-end workspace, latents and 48 kHz audio of one sentence

psram_regions.name: voice_npu
psram_regions.what: Voice networks' activations (hyperRAM pool of the flow and vocoder compiles)
